{{Quote|Imperial Intelligence's Internal Security division is currently investigating Talmont.|Governor [[Tour Aryon]], about Prefect [[Eugene Talmont]]|<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Governor Tour Aryon}}</ref>}}
The '''Internal Security Branch''', known as '''IntSec''', was a branch within [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Internal Organization Bureau/Legends|Internal Organization Bureau]]. IntSec was charged with the physical security of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] facilities and personnel. Originally considered a posting for those who were unambitious, IntSec revamped itself in the wake of the increasing threat posed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Their personnel and procedures were upgraded and retooled; however, the stigma of their previous incarnation remained and they were often the butt of jokes through Intelligence. IntSec personnel were the only Intelligence personnel permitted to openly carry weapons. They also employed plainclothes operatives who patrolled outside Intelligence installations to spot and contain potential threats before they arose.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==History==
At some point during the Empire's reign, [[Ysanne Isard]] served as the [[Director/Legends|Security Director]] of Internal Security.<ref name="Wizards" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Internal Security investigated the [[Imperial Prefect]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Eugene Talmont]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Internal Security Branch was first mentioned in ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''.<ref name="ISB" /> The [[2003]] "[[Coruscant: Center of the Empire]]" abbreviated Imperial Intelligence's Internal Security to ISB,<ref name="Wizards" /> although the ''Imperial Sourcebook'' stated that the ISB was an abbreviation of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], which it established to be a rival organization of the Internal Security Branch and the Imperial Intelligence.<ref name="ISB" />
